$comment: The author's own labels, collected blind on 2026-09-10: the sheet showed neither which model wrote which member nor which member was constructed, and A/B order was shuffled per pair. 'tie' is a real answer, not a skip -- forcing a choice where none exists manufactures disagreement. Agreement with the 7 constructed pairs' own construction was 7/7, and the natural pairs split 8 A / 7 B / 1 tie, so the set carries no position bias.

corrections.reason: The unchosen member reads 'Кількість молоком ...' -- the instrumental where the genitive 'молока' is required, and it also drops the final full stop. An objective error of case, not a matter of taste; the author confirmed the correction explicitly. The pair was surfaced by TEXT SIMILARITY (0.97), a criterion independent of what any judge said -- selecting labels to re-check by where a judge disagreed would tilt the reference toward that judge. The author's other near-identical pairs (CAL-20, CAL-09) were labelled consistently with this correction, so it reads as a single slip across 23 dense pairs, not a pattern.

excluded.reason: DEGENERATE: both members are byte-identical -- two different models produced exactly the same sentence. The pair can discriminate nothing and belongs in no denominator. A defect in the set builder, which sampled two models per prompt without checking they had written different text; fixed in scripts/build_judge_calibration_set.py. Kept in the file rather than deleted so the exclusion is visible.
